messages.subject: Error with binary model in refineqtl
parts:

Maridel

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Error with binary model in refineqtl
parts:
The problem seems to be that refineqtl() is not dealing with NA values in the LOD scores. Like stepwiseqtl() has the same problem. With your particular data, Maridel, there's segregation distortion which is leading to difficulty in fitting the two-QTL model when the QTL are in particular positions.

I'm working on a fix, and should have it done within the next week or so.

karl
